name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-taskqueue
description: Client-level task queue: dump non-urgent ideas, auto-execute during off-peak (cheap) windows, at set times, or right after a container restart (--on restart / -r / when="restart" (v0.6.1 adds the single-dash -r alias for iOS), detected via PID1 starttime change, one attempt per restart); v0.4.0 adds /queue RPC channel (list/edit/cancel/runnow) for the editable queue panel in dsh-notice-banner; v0.5.0 adds queued-sending state (dispatched but still waiting in target session inbox) that remains cancelable — cancel withdraws the queued message via Inbox.remove; v0.7.0 adds off-peak travel mode (错峰出行模式): when enabled in settings, all messages sent during peak hours are auto-queued via /queue RPC add instead of reaching the LLM — client bundle intercepts session.prompt; v0.8.0 adds per-session bypass (单会话豁免, mode.exempt RPC + exempt map in offpeak-mode.json, toggle in the input-row pill next to the Full access select) and moves the notice from the floating dock above the input into the composer row with a matching input-card border tint (:has() CSS) — local helper plugin, not an official package; v0.8.5 (2026-09-12) intercepts conversation.sendSession (the composer sink) BEFORE session.beginSubmission so a peak-intercepted message leaves NO local optimistic echo (the "message appears then vanishes on refresh" ghost), leaves only the agent confirm prompt + the queue banner, truncates the enqueue banner content preview to 40 chars, and makes restart-triggered tasks honour off-peak too (restart during peak arms the task persistently and it runs in the next off-peak window, one attempt per restart); v0.8.4 (2026-09-12) restores the blank-session engage turn (新会话转正, anti session-mixing) that silently died in 0.1.2 because session.events no longer exists (blank was always false) — readSessionEvents()/isBlankSession() now read snapshotEvents()/ownEvents() and all 5 former session.events call sites are adapted; RPC add returns engaged for diagnostics; v0.8.3 (2026-09-12) fixes the 0.1.2 session-scope slot contract (conversation.input.left passes sessionId/useSession instead of session, which silently removed the pill AND left the prompt interceptor uninstalled) and adds a debug forced-window override (mode.debug: peak/offpeak/auto, server+client share one peak verdict) plus client diagnostics reporting (/queue diag -> log/taskqueue/offpeak-debug.log) with window.__dshTaskqueueDebug; v0.8.2 (2026-09-02) collapses the input-row status pill into a small icon on mobile (viewport ≤640px, like the Full access control) and opens a click popover with the full status text, a short explanation and the per-session bypass (本会话立即发送) switch — the switch now lives inside the popover at every width, replacing the v0.8.1 word-only short labels and the v0.8.0 inline pill switch; v0.9.0 (2026-09-14) adds the peak-pause gate (高峰暂停闸门): while off-peak travel mode is on, a running agent turn is parked at the END OF THE CURRENT STEP (agent/pre-step waterfall middleware, awaited before next()) and resumes automatically when the off-peak window arrives — not an abort, and zero tokens while waiting because the next LLM request is never issued; a single shared 15s poller (only alive while waiters exist, cleaned up via ctx.effect) releases every waiter, one resolver each. Release reasons are immediate: off-peak reached / enabled=false / pause=false / session exempt / question card answer ① (rest of this turn runs through) / signal aborted (stop button). Two frozen safety rules: it never pauses at step 1 or while the step still carries pending messages (Inbox.claim() deletes persistently, so pausing there could silently lose a user message across a restart) and any error inside the gate fails open (immediate next(), next() called exactly once per step). New global sub-switch pause in offpeak-mode.json (default true, normalised on read and write; master switch off disables it), a per-session-per-peak-window question card (① continue to end of this turn ② stay paused until off-peak ③ exempt this session persistently; no answer / unparsable / DELEGATED_CALLER caller = stay paused silently), session banners on pause (⏸ 已暂停 · 高峰窗口 … · 预计 HH:MM 继续) and on release (▶ 已恢复执行（低谷）), slash command /queue pause [on|off|status], RPC mode.get now returns pause + paused{count,sessions[]} and mode.set accepts an optional pause (omitted field = unchanged) plus a dedicated mode.pause endpoint, diag events pause.enter/release/skip/ask (skip throttled to one line per session+reason per 5 min), exported pure helper nextOffpeakAt(windows, now) (weekdaysOnly / cross-window / cross-weekend aware), and a client bundle that finally surfaces the state: a ⏸ 暂停中 pill state with an 「已暂停 · 预计 HH:MM 继续」status line and two switches in the composer popover (global peak-pause + per-session bypass, both with RPC-failure resync fallback) — the peak-pause switch is also mirrored in the settings card; v0.10.0 (2026-09-14) reworks the two global switches into genuinely parallel defaults: G1 off-peak travel mode (peak messages are queued, unchanged) and G2 auto-pause (whether a running turn parks at the step boundary), managed automatically per time-window episode — entering peak sets pause=true and CLEARS the manual override, entering off-peak sets pause=(manual override===true) so off-peak defaults to off while a manual "on" survives, and each boundary is applied exactly once via a persisted episode key (offpeak-mode.json.pauseEpoch, computed by the pure exported currentEpisode(mode, windows, now)); pause no longer requires enabled=true, so auto-pause works while off-peak travel mode is off. Per-session exemptions are now two: exempt (S1, messages send straight through) and the new pauseExempt (S2, this session never parks; already-parked turns are released immediately) moved into the composer popover as the only two switches there while both global switches live in the settings card (renamed 自动暂停); a pause entered during peak waits for the trough (min-lead 5min, question card ①continue-this-turn ②stay-until-trough ③exempt-this-session) whereas a manual pause during off-peak parks immediately with no min-lead and no ETA — banner 已暂停 · 等待你确认（平峰手动暂停）, question card without the "stay until trough" option, and the question card is the only release path; mode.get adds pauseManual/pauseExempt/pauseEpoch and paused[].mode (peak|offpeak), mode.set{pause} and /queue pause on|off record a manual override, mode.exempt accepts exempt and/or pauseExempt, and diag gains pause.auto for boundary applications plus mode on pause.enter and pause-exempt as a skip/release reason
